hero.heading: Your dashboard
hero.subHtml: Manage your account, license, and affiliate area for SEXTOLUGAR.

account.title: Account & access
account.sub: Your license linkage and game access are managed here.
account.helper: This license will be tied to the logged-in account and cannot be used by another account.

purchases.title: My packs & purchases
purchases.sub: Unlocked content — available on any device.

affiliate.title: Affiliate
affiliate.sub: Share your link, earn coins, and request payouts.
affiliate.coinsHintHtml: You earn 10 coins per sale approved through your link.
affiliate.withdrawHintHtml: With 100 coins, you can request R$ 90.00 via Pix.
affiliate.withdrawHelperHtml: The payout becomes available when you reach the minimum of 100 withdrawable coins and have a Pix key registered.

summary.title: Summary
summary.textHtml: Your account can have a linked license and also take part in the referral system. Game access is granted once the license is validated and this account's token is active in this browser.
